This plot is small, only 0.06 hectares, and I am renting it, so I will not spend much cash on it. I will put some manure from my animals since that costs me nothing, and I will use my own local millet seed that I saved from last harvest like we always do here in Tigray. Fertilizer from the shop is expensive and the rains can fail, so I would rather save that money for my bigger plots. My wife and children will help me weed and harvest, and I do not need to hire anyone for such a small piece of land.
